headline: FlixBus Injects $11 Million to Expand Bus Fleet for Summer Season in Chile
summary: German intercity bus operator FlixBus will add 120 new buses in Chile ahead of the summer season through an $11 million capital injection. Local partners will contribute an additional $16 million to expand fleet operations.
why: FlixBus is a mobility provider owned by Germany's Flix SE, operating intercity bus networks across Europe and the Americas.

impacts.name: FlixBus
impacts.why: FlixBus injected $11 million to add 120 buses to its Chilean transport network.
